meta.title: Pricing
meta.description: Everything you need to accept bookings online for {price}/month: unlimited bookings, your own booking page, calendar, reminders, team members and more. {days}-day free trial, no card required.

hero.title: Everything you need to accept bookings online.
hero.lead: One simple plan for {price} a month. Every feature included, whatever the size of your business.

unlimited.title: Unlimited bookings
unlimited.text: Take as many appointments as you like.

noFees.title: No per-booking fees
noFees.text: We never take a cut of what you charge.

billing.title: Billing questions
billing.lead: Straight answers about trials, invoices and cancelling. Anything else, we’re happy to help.

card.q: Do I need a card for the free trial?
card.a: No. Start your {days}-day trial with just your email address. You only add a payment method when you decide to subscribe.

how.a: Your subscription is {price} per month, billed in advance through Stripe, our payment provider. Receipts and invoices are available from the billing portal.

cancel.a: Open the Stripe billing portal from your billing settings and cancel there. No emails or calls needed. Cancelling stops future renewals.

vat.a: Yes. {price} a month is the full price, including Greek VAT of 24%. Nothing is added at checkout, and you receive an invoice for every payment.

update.q: Can I update my card or billing details?
update.a: Yes. The billing portal lets you change your payment method, update billing details and download past invoices at any time.

team.a: No. Team members are included in the same plan, so your whole team can use the calendar and take bookings.

card.trial: {days}-day free trial. No card required to start. No per-booking fees.
